policy: AI scans open GitHub issues labeled 'feature-request', filters spam, scores user value vs. UI clutter, and classifies accepted ideas into rollout='default' (everyone) or rollout='settings-toggle' (OPT_FEATURES in Settings) in priority order.

items.title: Separate SFX (on by default) and Tron-style Synth music (off by default) toggles
items.rationale: Tactile game-pick chimes delight immediately while music should always stay opt-in.

items.title: Thank-you postcards & non-competitive Letters to the Makers
items.rationale: Core mission: remind shuttered/forgotten studios and creators that their worlds carried players through growing up, without turning into a popularity contest.

items.title: Custom shareable themed lists & 'Games That Made Me Sweat' shelf
items.rationale: High social shareability via serverless #list-... links without cluttering onboarding.

items.title: Industry / Maker career credit controls ('I worked on this')
items.rationale: Deeply meaningful for game industry folks (~5% of visitors) while keeping everyday player cards clean by default.

items.title: Era cultural touchstone strips ('Meanwhile in the world')
items.rationale: Great nostalgic context, toggleable in Settings and timeline toolbar.
